title: Handshakes Launches AI Agent to Transform Corporate Due Diligence and Investigation

body: Handshakes Launches AI Agent to Transform Corporate Due Diligence and Investigation PR Newswire
summaryZh: Handshakes公司推出了专门针对企业尽职调查和合规调查的AI Agent产品，旨在通过自动化数据搜集与分析来简化企业审查流程。原始信息显示：Handshakes Launches AI Agent to Transform Corporate Due Diligence and Investigation PR Newswire。该消息由PR Newswire发布，主题为“Handshakes Launches AI Agent to Transform Corporate Due Diligence and Investigation”。其重要性主要体现在：展示了AI Agent在企业尽职调查和调查领域的垂直落地应用。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
